parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists in the same `Wallpaper` package. The structural signal is that they share the same syntactic shape (a type alias declaration at roughly the same line offset), but `StitchableWallpaperView`, `SwiftUIWallpaperView`, `CompositeWallpaperView`, and `ThemeDebugControlsGenerator` are clearly distinct domain concepts — three are renderer view aliases and one is a debug-UI generator alias — whose coincidence is purely structural (both occupy a single `typealias` line with no members). Because `fields_or_signature` is empty for every record, there is no shared member body to consolidate, and the `shared_field_count: 2` in `structural_evidence` most likely reflects the two structural slots of a type-alias declaration itself rather than any meaningful shared API surface. Merging or extracting these aliases would conflate unrelated abstractions without reducing any real duplication.
